info.description: Integration settings managed here instead of server/.env: Social channels (Meta, TikTok), PromptPay and Slip2Go. A filled field overrides .env; an empty field uses .env. Saved changes apply within seconds, no restart. Secret fields are encrypted when saved (they then show as v1.…): to change one, clear it and paste the new value. Server-only settings (database, JWT, SOCIAL_TOKEN_KEY, PUBLIC_URL) stay in .env.

metaAppId.description: META_APP_ID. Meta app → App settings → Basic → App ID. Register the redirect URI <PUBLIC_URL>/api/social/callback/meta in Facebook Login settings.

metaAppSecret.description: META_APP_SECRET (secret, encrypted on save). Meta app → App settings → Basic → App secret.

metaGraphVersion.description: META_GRAPH_VERSION, e.g. v27.0. Empty = .env or v27.0.

metaLoginConfigId.description: META_LOGIN_CONFIG_ID (optional): a Facebook Login for Business configuration ID. When set, it replaces the permission list.

tiktokClientKey.description: TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY. TikTok app → Client key. Register the redirect URI <PUBLIC_URL>/api/social/callback/tiktok in Login Kit (must be https).

tiktokAudited.description: TIKTOK_AUDITED. Turn on once TikTok approved Direct Post (until then TikTok posts can only be private). Empty = .env.

socialTestMode.description: SOCIAL_FAKE. Local testing only: stand-in Meta/TikTok so Connect and Test can be tried without real apps. Always ignored in production.

promptpayId.description: PROMPTPAY_ID. Payee mobile number or 13-digit ID used to build the payment QR.

promptpayName.description: PROMPTPAY_NAME. Shown next to the QR.

receiverAccountType.description: PAYMENT_RECEIVER_ACCOUNT_TYPE. 02001 PromptPay phone · 02003 national/tax ID · 02004 e-wallet · 01004 KBank account. Empty = from PromptPay type.

receiverAccountNumber.description: PAYMENT_RECEIVER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER. Digits only. Empty = PromptPay ID.

receiverNameTh.description: PAYMENT_RECEIVER_NAME_TH. Registered Thai account name WITHOUT title (นาย/นาง…), exactly as the bank shows it. Leave empty unless sure: a wrong name fails every slip.

receiverBankAccount.description: PAYMENT_RECEIVER_BANK_ACCOUNT. Bank account behind the PromptPay ID (digits); many slips show this instead of the phone number.

receiverBankType.description: PAYMENT_RECEIVER_BANK_TYPE. Bank of that account: 01004 KBank, 01014 SCB, 01002 BBL, 01006 KTB, 01025 Krungsri…

slip2goApiUrl.description: SLIP2GO_API_URL. API URL from the Slip2Go dashboard (Settings → API Connect), https.

slip2goSecretKey.description: SLIP2GO_SECRET_KEY (secret, encrypted on save). From the Slip2Go dashboard.

slip2goAutoApprove.description: SLIP2GO_AUTO_APPROVE. On = slips Slip2Go verifies are approved automatically; off = they still wait for staff. Empty = .env.

slip2goGenerateQr.description: SLIP2GO_GENERATE_QR. On = checkout QR from Slip2Go (checked: our receiver + exact amount); off = built locally. Empty = .env.

paymentOrderTtlMinutes.description: PAYMENT_ORDER_TTL_MINUTES. Payment window: only transfers made inside it are approved automatically. Empty = .env.
